g.title: crate Own document and workspace sessions through abstract runtime ports.
crate::document Hold authoritative document state and application-owned preview snapshots.
crate::error Report session consistency and engine failures.
crate::index Index sessions by document URI and session identity.
crate::operations Typed workspace operation outcomes and filesystem operation port.
crate::positions Hash document text and translate native positions to UTF-8 byte offsets.
crate::preview_state Publish preview snapshots and reject stale navigation.
crate::preview_tests Verify preview framing, revisions, cache lifetime, and cancellation.
crate::requests Define native document updates, attachment and synchronization values.
crate::snapshots Frame core snapshots with application-owned preview identities and revisions.
crate::test_plugins Provide deterministic abstract plugin execution for application tests.
crate::tests Verify session synchronization and workspace reconfiguration.
crate::workspace Associate workspace roots with abstract plugin execution and render policies.
